entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A methodology for Retrieval-Augmented Generation that leverages graphs, defined by a workflow of G-Indexing, G-Retrieval, and G-Generation.

entities.name: G-Indexing
entities.description: A component of the GraphRAG workflow involving the indexing of graph data.

entities.name: G-Retrieval
entities.description: A component of the GraphRAG workflow involving the retrieval of relevant graph structures.

entities.name: G-Generation
entities.description: A component of the GraphRAG workflow involving the generation of responses based on retrieved graph data.

entities.description: The downstream task addressed by the GraphRAG framework as shown in the overview figure.
